method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: Creates MapFrame then MapKey. MapKey menu_loaded calls local/super handler, sizes to safe area only outside PC, dispatches children if unhandled and returns that result. Registers close and optional postload, then adds MapFrame as custom gain-focus widget and returns self. This container does not compute map coordinates or process map input; native focus and map provider remain external.
unknowns: Per-body nil/error/return/lifetime limits are explicit in ordered operations; no universal cleanup, cancellation or exception recovery is inferred.
Recovered-source fidelity defects remain visible; saved AST/receipt checks are not independent correctness review.

summary.answer: Initializes scoreboard and CodCaster models and activeTab only if unset, then builds team scoreboard/map/inventory. PC visibility predicates require input mode, scoreboard/force conditions and activeTab; nonmouse Visible/ForceVisible use their explicit bit/model tests. SetState switches inventory-open state, focus and cleanup, including multi-item-pickup/cursor helpers. Model/input subscriptions update presentation. Gameplay inventory changes and original native UI lifetime are not proved by these visibility calls.

Additional same-class reset/clip/close body ranges are available but outside the frozen author scope; exact locators are in unfrozen_same_class_body_locators and source-frontier.json. No body authoring or completion credit for them.

summary.answer: On the supplied instance, close f3_arg0.MapFrame, then f3_arg0.MapKey, in exactly this order. Reuse the stopped constructor close registration; child/native teardown and errors remain external.
